record.question: The Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Rajiv Kumar. NITI Aayog’s contemporary CV states Dr. Rajiv Kumar took over as Vice-Chairman on 1 September 2017. He held the post during the 2018 paper context. Historical/source note: Historical officeholder; the source year does not establish any present office. Reference: https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2018-12/RajicKumarCV.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
